verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a requests-per-second or requests-per-minute limit enforced on an API key, nor when throttling begins. The only related item is a Usage API that reports real-time credit and concurrency usage. That is an adjacent capability, a concurrency counter rather than a documented rate-limit threshold, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the documented rate limit (requests per second or minute) enforced on my API key before throttling kicks in
